errors.evidence: The machine-generated description omits the "(←)" symbol from the y-axis label, which is present in the figure and indicates that lower values are better.
The description states the ST-ES line starts at approximately 17.25. The plot shows the starting value is just above the 17.00 tick mark, at approximately 17.1.
The description states the ST-ES line decreases to around 15.00 at 2 examples. The plot shows the value at 2 examples is clearly below the 15.00 line, at approximately 14.9.
The description states the ST-ES line decreases to about 14.80 at 6 examples. The plot shows the value at 6 examples is below 14.75, which is the midpoint between 14.5 and 15.0.
For the Random line, the description states it decreases to about 16.50 at 2 examples. The plot shows the value at 2 examples is slightly below the 16.50 line, at approximately 16.45.
